criteria.hard_driver: Prompt 01 start; every response including IN_PROGRESS returns one literal cumulative ZIP/checkpoint/manifest trio; continue stays in the prompt; next follows COMPLETE only; replacement chat uses newest trio including IN_PROGRESS; P02+ verifies current or COMPLETE predecessor trio.
criteria.literal_prompts_and_ranges: Exactly 45 sequential literal prompt headers, one matching strict marker per prompt, no placeholders, literal range evidence, a packet range/map control, and explicit exact-coverage/disposition language.
criteria.production: Source replay precedes salvage; source/English/apparatus stay separate and monolingual; hashed image fallback and copy-matter exclusion are explicit.
criteria.closure: Deterministic integration, Session-45 fresh non-patching cold audit, and no human/publication gate are explicit.
criteria.integrity: Native manifest hashes/bytes and native receipt hashes are consistent; exact direct-file snapshot is identical before and after the cold audit.
